failures_selection_and_unknowns.summary: Complete model baseline established; no optimization A/B. Automatic freeze_gc failed for C1/C4 but succeeded for separate profiling; C4 native identity sampling overlapped early formal timing. Do not present as bare production speed.

Initial Triton and public TileLang tail each passed94/96; initial downstream BF16 T128 error reached10ULP and T2048 reached13040ULP. Ordered reductions then passed96/96 without relaxing atol2e-7/rtol2e-6/maxrel2e-5 and BF16<=1ULP. The first Triton harness used a copied reference, while the later harness exercised actual False/True pre paths; these two component runs are not a kernel-only A/B. Ordered Triton remains an alternative, not the full-model B.

Release wheel four ELFs required GLIBC2.38 while target was2.35; no libc upgrade. Isolated frontend/CANN coexistence5cases had2success/3failure. Selected B uses ctypes AOT and current stream, not importing private TileLang/TVM in the model process. AOT probe01 refused before96cases at Git-clean guard; dirty cause UNKNOWN. Probe02 and full-model canonical04 use ed216.

First A failed before requests in ModelSlim/CANN format_cast; second A was refused by occupancy preflight before a model child. Preliminary success used differing service seeds and is not canonical04. Old B01/02/03 plans were not executed. R3 profile auto-stop/export succeeded; the final HTTP500 was a repeated STOP, not capture failure. Preserve original protocol UNKNOWN separately from the correction.

Target KPool readback sets per11WK calls changed44copies to4 (-90.91% target calls), not -90.91% all copies or latency. C4 two blocks had opposite throughput directions. Full native-map closure remained NOT_ESTABLISHED after4416-group ValueError.

Copy/allocation dispatch per normalized CPU-step decreased about10, but stacks were disabled and exact KV/query site counts remain UNKNOWN. Formal four-pair directions improved; magnitude varied. Known native subsets do not close every mapped library or ABA/native mutation behavior.

Only2048/4096 prefill budgets differed. Keep2048 baseline: B C1 TTFT p50 improved about2%, C4 p50 regressed about1.4-1.6% while p99 improved about2.7-3.0%; decode/TPS varied and sampled HBM rose1120-1123reportedMB. Original B port preflight Errno98 occurred before prepare; committed continuation ran only original remaining9 points, with no model/request replay. Some control stderr was not retained; exact historical control cause is UNKNOWN. No new R6 profile.

not_executed_or_not_established: This public contribution contains code and compact numeric evidence, not a mirror of private raw evidence. Fixed private-source links require separate permission.
No prompts, raw SSE, raw server logs, full environment, authentication information, machine addresses, weights, compiled libraries, caches or profiler traces are copied.
R2 is 512/128 under its recorded diagnostic/GC/observer conditions. R3-R6 main A/B is 16384/1024. No cross-round cumulative acceleration or fair R2-to-R6 speedup is established.
R3 canonical04 excludes successful preliminary services with different server seeds; their metrics remain separately listed.

R4 has one service lifetime per configuration/concurrency with two within-service blocks. R5/R6 have two independent services per configuration/concurrency. These are descriptive experiments, not confidence intervals or production qualification.
TPOT is first-to-last nonempty SSE receipt interval divided by output_tokens-1, not exact token ITL. HBM observations are periodic samples, not continuous peaks.

Finite natural-stop checks are not full precision/logit/MoE-routing/long-state equivalence certification. Graph/MTP/PD, other hardware, long stability and full native/code-generation closure are not established.
Full-device critical-path attribution cannot be independently reconstructed from this compact package. Host-self and multi-rank duration sums are not request wall-clock savings.
Exact benchmark replay additionally requires the omitted controlled workload and environment artifacts; a fresh public workload is a new experiment and cannot inherit these results.
